observer: The exact bytes delivered by the real decompression stream up to EOF on four valid frames.
domainBasis: The expected payloads are the independent bytes used to build the finite input frames. XZ uses Python liblzma. LZ4 uses literal blocks with an independent libxxhash header and content checksum.
